document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You spend individual time with each party member, sharing 
experiences  from  other  field  trips.  Your  personal  touch  is 
enough  to  keep  spirits  up  for  a  few  more  days.  One  foggy 
morning, Bernard and Norman call you down to the river to 
share an incredible find: a large, strong canoe in need of a few 
minor repairs. There is no sign of its owner. Now you must 
make an important decision.

To return downriver, go to 32. To proceed deeper into Hanninah 
country, go to 20.
